summary.title: App Router | Next.js
summary.one_liner: Next.js Foundations course intro: build a full-stack financial dashboard app covering routing, data fetching, server actions, auth and metadata.
takeaways: The course builds a financial dashboard with a public home page, login page, protected dashboard pages, and invoice add/edit/delete.
Topics include styling, image/link/font optimization, nested layouts, data fetching with Postgres on Vercel, and streaming.
Search and pagination are implemented with URL search params; mutations use React Server Actions with cache revalidation.
Authentication uses NextAuth.js and Proxy; the course also covers error handling and metadata.
Prerequisites: basic React and JavaScript, Node.js 20.9 or later, and GitHub and Vercel accounts.
summary.summary: This is the opening page of the free, interactive Next.js Foundations course, which teaches Next.js by building a full-stack financial dashboard. It outlines the app's features (public home page, login, protected dashboard, invoice CRUD) and previews the course topics, including routing, data fetching, server actions, authentication, and metadata. It lists prerequisites (basic React/JavaScript, Node.js 20.9+, GitHub and Vercel accounts) and points to the React Foundations course for newcomers. The page itself is an overview; the hands-on material starts with chapter 1, Getting Started.
